info.cls_ename: Department of Environmental Engineering and Science

description.describe_ch: 了解並實際操作噪音儀器。實驗共計有四項主題：道路噪音實驗、航空噪音實驗、殘響實驗、隔音實驗及soundplan軟體使用等，每項實驗需完成一份實驗報告書。
description.describe_eh: Provides students with an understanding and the instrument operation for measuring noise in practice. Four different kinds of field measurements are included in this course; aircraft noise, traffic noise, reverberant chamber, transmission loss test and Soundplan softward operation. Four field measurement reports are required.

targets.describe_ch: 能清楚理解噪音及振動學的原理並應用在日常生活的情形上
targets.describe_en: To comprehension the principle of noise and vibration for applying to daily life.

targets.describe_ch: 能使用相關設備定量噪音及振動，並由分析結果歸納出合理的結論
targets.describe_en: Be able to use related equipment to measure noise and vibration ,and analysis appropriate conclusions from measurement.

targets.describe_ch: 針對特定環境噪音問題，運用所學設計合理監測方法，加以驗證並提解決方案
targets.describe_en: To apply the knowledge to design a reasonable monitor method for a specific environment, conduct the experiment , and draw appropriate conclusion.

targets.describe_ch: 能透過小組合作與分工培養團隊合作能力
targets.describe_en: To compose the team spirit through teamwork.

targets.describe_ch: 針對特定環境噪音問題，運用所學設計合理監測方法及解決方案以具備執行實務所需之技能
targets.describe_en: Applying the knowledge to design a reasonable monitor and control method for a specific environmental noise and build up their field skill.

targets.describe_ch: 認識當代環境噪音議題並能持續學習提昇環境專業管理能力。
targets.describe_en: Know the current environmental noise and consistently learn to enhance the project management.

targets.describe_ch: 理解學術倫理以及不當研究行為的嚴重性。
targets.describe_en: Understand academic ethics and the seriousness of research misconduct

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 實驗課程未到者如未有請假者扣平時成績遲到者第一次口頭警告再犯扣分/交通噪音實作場域(路邊或軌道)需要注意安全規範/當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。當您簡報時，您應該面對自己的小組或全班同學大聲說話，讓同學能聽清楚。允許使用筆記型電腦或平板等載具，進行課堂記筆記，否則應將其收起。要確保在上課時，關閉手機、PDA等移動設備，並收起及保持靜音。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: 希望各位同學能按授課進度完成各項學習任務，有規矩地、主動積極地參與各項學習活動、準時繳交作業，完成各項學習任務，並符合本課程的學習目標者，以獲得應得的成績。若您在學期間遇到學習上的困難，請善用我的請益時間、或與我另約其他時段，也可先與助教討論共同尋求改善方案。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: 禁止抄襲，引用國家標準或其他人論文研究或報告必須清楚交代註明。禁止使用ChatGPT等AI撰寫報告內容，如有違反先予告知並酌減扣分，再犯該項不予計分；屢犯不改則依校規處理並學科成績不及格。

courseBankC.describe_en: To comprehension the principle of noise and vibration for applying to daily life.
courseBankC.core_item: 具備理解環境議題之語文、數學，科學與工程知識的基本能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Able to acquire knowledge in languages, mathematics, science and engineering, as well as an understanding of environmental issues.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 能使用相關設備定量噪音及振動，並由分析結果歸納出合理的結論
courseBankC.describe_en: Be able to use related equipment to measure noise and vibration ,and analysis appropriate conclusions from measurement.
courseBankC.core_item: 發掘、分析、應用研究成果及兼顧環境永續發展，以解決複雜且整合性工程問題的能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Able to identify and resolve problems.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 針對特定環境噪音問題，運用所學設計合理監測方法，加以驗證並提解決方案
courseBankC.describe_en: To apply the knowledge to design a reasonable monitor method for a specific environment, conduct the experiment , and draw appropriate conclusion.
courseBankC.core_item: 執行實驗操作、解析數據與歸納結論的專業能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Able to carry out experiments, analyze data and draw conclusions.

courseBankC.describe_en: To compose the team spirit through teamwork.
courseBankC.core_item: 具備計畫管理、溝通協調與團隊合作的能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Possess project management competencies, as well as communication, coordination and team collaboration skills.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 針對特定環境噪音問題，運用所學設計合理監測方法及解決方案以具備執行實務所需之技能
courseBankC.describe_en: Applying the knowledge to design a reasonable monitor and control method for a specific environmental noise and build up their field skill.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 認識當代環境噪音議題並能持續學習提昇環境專業管理能力。
courseBankC.describe_en: Know the current environmental noise and consistently learn to enhance the project management.
courseBankC.core_item: 瞭解當代工程及文明對環境永續議題、社會共好及全球發展的影響，並能持續終身學習。
courseBankC.core_eng: Able to understand contemporary environmental issues, strengthen professional environmental management competencies and pursue lifelong learning opportunities.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 理解學術倫理以及不當研究行為的嚴重性。

courseBankC.core_eng: Able to comprehend professional engineering ethics and social responsibility, as well as cultivate self-discipline.
